# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose.
The Document described understanding of changes required on Order Access Procurement Approval and Auto Material Reallocation.

# Business Requirement
Currently PO excess approver logic treat inquiry order procurement in it which we require to be excluded while validating excess procurement qty. The simple reason is inquiry orders gets spitted into confirmed orders and procurements already started against inquiry orders. So at one point of time, inquiry order indent line will be 0 and all the revision of PO/Creation will lead to excess procurement approval

# Section2. Assumptions
Section3. Solution

# Functional Requirements

### 1. PO Excess Procurement Issue
Currently, the PO excess approver logic “Order Access Procurement Approval” incorrectly includes inquiry order procurement while validating excess procurement quantity. This needs to be excluded.
The reason is that inquiry orders are later split into confirmed orders, and procurement activities (indent, RMPO, GRN) are already initiated based on the inquiry order. As a result, at a certain stage:
• Inquiry order quantity becomes 0
• Confirmed (summary) order quantity reflects the actual requirement
However, during PO revision or creation, the system still considers this as excess procurement and triggers unnecessary approval, even though:
• At the Main OC / Style level, the total quantity remains unchanged and within limits

#### Example Scenario:
• Inquiry Order = 200
• Indent generated
• RMPO created against indent
• GRN created
• Summary Order received and split into Summary OCs (Total = 200)
• Inquiry Order = 0
• Summary Order = 200
• Indent revised
• During RMPO revision, system flags Excess Quantity and asks for approval
This is incorrect because the actual requirement has not changed.
Reference Example: MTX-002073-001 (Metrex Test)

### 2. Auto Material Allocation Issue After GRN
Currently, Auto Material Allocation works in the following scenarios:
• During OC splitting
• When new Summary OCs are added or deleted under the Main OC
However, once a GRN is created against the inquiry order, this functionality stops working.

#### Expected Requirement:
Auto Material Allocation should continue to function even after GRN creation against the inquiry order.
There is an existing setting:
• “Auto Material Re-Allocation from Excess Indent Material Only”
When enabled, it works correctly only if GRN is not created.
Observed Cases:
1. After RMPO Creation
• Auto allocation works correctly
• Excess quantity from inquiry order (when it becomes 0) gets allocated to confirmed orders during MRL generation. Ex- MTX-002080-027
2. After Supplier ASN Creation
• Behavior remains same as Case 1
3. After GRN Creation
• Auto allocation does not work
• Since stock is already allocated to the inquiry order and its quantity becomes 0, excess material is not reallocated to confirmed orders

### Required Enhancement:
The system should allow reallocation of stock (even after GRN) from inquiry orders to:
• Split OCs
• Newly added inquiry/confirmed OCs under the same Main OC.

### Validations Rules:
• The stock should be allocated to orders under the same Main OC, whether through splits or newly added orders.
• The stock will be deallocated from the OC where the required quantity becomes zero or falls below the ordered quantity, and will then be reallocated to the appropriate OCs.
• If the stock has already been unreserved or reallocated to other orders, the auto allocation functionality will not be applicable.

### Note:
If the second requirement (Auto Material Allocation after GRN) is implemented, the first issue will automatically be resolved. This is because:
• Inquiry order lines with 0 quantity will be removed during MRL generation
• Hence, excess procurement validation will no longer be incorrectly triggered
Only in cases where the stock has already been unreserved or reallocated to other orders then only Order Access Procurement Approval will apply; therefore, no changes are required for the 1st Requirement.
